held_back_and_why.school: Schools and school districts are major commercial HVAC buyers. BROAD 'school' blocks 'commercial hvac installation for schools'.
held_back_and_why.rental: Property managers run rental buildings. The pack itself says to preserve 'property manager'; blocking 'rental' works against that.

notes.why_a_subset_is_still_compliant: The instruction permits only negatives from the supplied pack. Every term here comes from the pack; four are deferred. Deferring is reversible from search-term evidence. Shipping a demand-blocking negative is not.
notes.conflict_testing: Tested against both positive keywords, every search term 2026-06-01..2026-09-09, all 75 targeted location names, and a 20-name supported-manufacturer list. Results recorded in evidence/2026-09-10d-commercial-neg-and-rsa.json.
notes.barred_categories_respected: No manufacturer name, location name, free, quote, estimate, cost, pricing, building, property manager, repair or maintenance negative is used.
